quests.title: Venture Towards the Moonlight

dialogue.t: Welcome, adventurer! Would you like me to check today's commissions for you?

dialogue.sit: Ahh... I feel at home already.

dialogue.t: Oh... Are you in a hurry? Can I help you with anything?
We're just super happy to see you, Katheryne! Hehe, you're the best!
Thank you for your kind words... Although, if you were attempting humor, I'm afraid I did not understand it...
Nevertheless, welcome to Nod-Krai, a land full of opportunities.
I'm sure you'll embark on grand adventures here and discover treasures beyond your wildest dreams.
Good luck, adventurers! Happy adventuring, and ad astra abyssosque!

quests.description: You once again encounter a familiar face at the Adventurers’ Guild in Nod-Krai…
